# Muse Chat Counter Live

A Muse skill that stamps a chat's exact per-message token count at the end of its title, so you can see context pressure from the chat list without opening the thread. It refreshes in-turn for free, with a 10-minute wake-on-drift hook as backstop, so it doesn't burn tokens on a standing cron. Built for any Muse user whose long chats need a live gauge before they hit a rotation threshold.
